name: Hanani
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Hanani the seer comes to Asa and rebukes him for relying on the king of Syria and not on the Most High, so the host of Syria has escaped his hand. Had he relied on the Most High, he would have delivered them as he did the Ethiopians.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 16: Asa Leans on Syria Instead of the Most High

points: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet Jehoshaphat and said, shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the Lord? Therefore is wrath upon thee from before the Lord. We got to be careful not to bring wrath upon us. We got to be careful not to bring wrath upon the congregation. The Lord does not like that thing right there.
